summary: Use the modal color as background and find same-color 8-connected foreground objects. Delete singleton objects. For each larger object's normalized shape, recolor it 1 when it is symmetric under top-bottom reflection, otherwise 3 when it is symmetric under left-right reflection, otherwise 6. The top-bottom test has precedence for objects symmetric on both axes.
